title: Grant's Lounge
venue_description:
Grant's Lounge - The Original Home of Southern Rock

Grant's Lounge is a legendary music venue located at 576 Poplar Street in downtown Macon Georgia. Since opening on February 16 1971 it has been a defining venue in American rock and soul music history. Widely known as The Original Home of Southern Rock Grant's Lounge has hosted iconic performances by the Allman Brothers Tom Petty Eric Clapton The Marshall Tucker Band Wet Willie and countless other legends who shaped the sound of rock and roll.

Nearly 55 Years of Music History

For nearly five decades Grant's Lounge has served as a cultural landmark and refuge for music lovers from all walks of life. The venue's back walls display autographed photos and memorabilia from legendary performances creating a living museum of American music history. Musicians from around the world travel to Macon specifically to perform at Grant's acknowledging its historic importance and authentic creative spirit.

Regular Programming

The venue hosts live music throughout the week with the legendary Sunday Night Jam hosted by Johnny Hollingsworth Jr being the most famous regular event. This long-running Sunday session brings together accomplished musicians local talent and traveling performers in spontaneous collaborative performances. The sessions are sit-in friendly welcoming musicians of all skill levels to join and create.

Music Diversity

While Grant's is historically associated with Southern rock the venue welcomes and features a diverse range of music including R&B Rock & Roll Blues Bluegrass and Country. This diversity reflects Macon's position as a nexus point in American music heritage where multiple musical traditions converge.

Authentic Dive Bar Atmosphere

Grant's maintains a raw authentic dive bar atmosphere with genuine warmth and welcome for all who enter. The intimate stage setting creates an up-close personal experience rare in modern venues. The wood-paneled interior and historic decor transport visitors back through decades of live music history. The casual welcoming vibe makes it as comfortable for seasoned musicians as for music fans experiencing live music for the first time.

Community & Legacy

Grant's Lounge is deeply rooted in Macon's identity as a music city. The venue functions as both a working music venue and a historical landmark. Regular patrons and musicians alike describe Grant's as more than a business - it is a vital community institution and gathering place that continues the legacy of Macon's contribution to American music.

Food & Drink

Full bar service with beer wine and spirits. Kitchen service including famous menu items. Comfortable seating and stage layout ideal for intimate live music experiences.
